title: Real Female Viking Warriors
hook: DNA tests on a 10th-century warrior grave proved the high-ranking chief was a woman.

scenes.text: For over a century, historians claimed Viking 'shieldmaidens' like Lagertha were merely mythical figures created for epic poetry.

scenes.text: In 1878, archaeologists in Birka, Sweden uncovered grave Bj 581: the ultimate archetype of a high-status Viking military officer.

scenes.text: The chamber contained a deadly steel sword, battle axe, fighting knife, two spears, twenty-five armor-piercing arrows, and two sacrificed warhorses.
